# The Oval, 120 Main South Road, Sockburn, Christchurch

The Oval is a proposed development of 16 new brick family homes at 120 Main South Road, Sockburn, Christchurch, New Zealand, being marketed off the plans.

- Home types: 10 detached two-storey homes in light cream brick (approx. 135 m², private outdoor living of about 57 to 60 m²) and 6 two-storey terrace homes in dark charcoal brick (approx. 119 to 125 m², about 46 m² private outdoor living). Areas are from the Revision G concept site plan.
- Homes sit around a private landscaped internal loop reached by a driveway off Main South Road; no through traffic.
- Nearby schools (approx. walk): Our Lady of Victories School (next door), Te Kāpehu Riccarton School (10 min), Riccarton High School (10 min), St Thomas of Canterbury College (12 min).
- Stage: concept site plan. Resource and building consents have not yet been granted; layouts and numbers may change.
- Pricing: not yet released; registered buyers see pricing first.
- Selling agent: Angela Webb, Residential, Investment & Development Sales, Bayleys (+64 27 349 1997, angela.webb@bayleys.co.nz). Whalan and Partners Ltd, licensed under the REA Act 2008.
- All images on the site are artist's impressions, concept only, not consented.
